title: Neighbour Help Request
scenario: A local group post claims a neighbour needs urgent cash but gives no verifiable details.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.C: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Neighbour Help Request: the trap is to make speed feel safer than verification. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Local requests still need verification before payment.
